children: SoSoValue data showed that HYPE spot ETFs recorded a total net inflow of $10.52 million on September 4, U.S. Eastern Time. According to Odaily, only Bitwise Hyperliquid ETF (BHYP) posted a net inflow that day, also totaling $10.52 million, bringing its cumulative historical net inflow to $164 million.
As of press time, HYPE spot ETFs had total net assets of $481 million, a HYPE net asset ratio of 2.56%, and cumulative net inflows of $357 million.

title: HYPE Spot ETFs Record $10.52 Million Net Inflow on September 4
